list: unfailable-command:grep -q 'WaveLabel' scenes/ui/hud.tscn && echo "OK: WaveLabel present" || echo "FAIL: WaveLabel missing"
unfailable-command:grep -q 'signal wave_cleared' scripts/game/swarm_manager.gd && echo "OK: signal declared" || echo "FAIL: signal missing"
unfailable-command:grep -q 'func set_wave' scripts/ui/hud.gd && echo "OK: set_wave defined" || echo "FAIL: set_wave missing"
unfailable-command:grep -q 'wave_cleared' scripts/game/main.gd && echo "OK: connection present" || echo "FAIL: connection missing"
unfailable-command:timeout 5 godot --headless --path . res://scenes/game/main.tscn 2>&1 | grep -i 'script error' && echo "FAIL: script errors found" || echo "OK: no script errors"
unfailable-command:git diff --name-only HEAD -- project.godot | grep -q 'project.godot' && echo "FAIL: project.godot modified" || echo "OK: project.godot unmodified"
unfailable-command:git diff --name-only HEAD -- scenes/units/enemy.tscn scripts/units/enemy.gd | grep -q . && echo "FAIL: enemy files modified" || echo "OK: enemy files unmodified"
unfailable-command:godot --headless --import --path . 2>&1 | grep -i 'error' && echo "FAIL: parse errors found" || echo "OK: no parse errors"
unfailable-command:timeout 2 godot --headless --path . --quit 2>&1 | grep -i 'error' && echo "FAIL: runtime error" || echo "OK: headless run clean"
unfailable-command:git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E '\.(png|ttf|ogg|wav|mp3|tscn|tres|godot|import)$' && echo "FAIL: asset/scene changed" || echo "PASS: no assets/scenes touched"
